name: Follow-ups & Reminders
description: Create one-time and recurring reminders from slash commands or any message, and manage them from a Mattermost-native sidebar. No external services required.

settings_schema.header: Create one-time and recurring reminders with the **/remind** slash command, or from any message's **Actions** menu. Reminders are delivered as direct messages from the Follow-ups bot and are stored in this plugin's key-value store — no external service is contacted.
settings_schema.footer: Changes to every setting take effect immediately, except **Scheduler interval**, which is applied on the next scheduler tick. See the [documentation](https://github.com/leightonrodney/mattermost-plugin-followups#configuration) for details.

settings.help_text: When disabled, users can still create and manage reminders but nothing is delivered. Reminders that come due while delivery is off are delivered late, once it is re-enabled, subject to the missed-reminder grace period.

How often the cluster-wide scheduler wakes to deliver due reminders. Lower values deliver closer to the requested minute at the cost of more key-value reads. Clamped to 10-900 seconds. Applied on the next tick.
Upper bound on scheduled (not yet delivered) reminders a single user may hold. Clamped to 1-10000.
Upper bound on repeating reminders a single user may hold. Counts toward the overall per-user limit as well. Clamped to 0-1000.
The soonest a reminder may be scheduled, and the shortest permitted gap between occurrences of a recurring reminder. Clamped to 30-86400 seconds.
The furthest into the future a reminder may be scheduled. Recurring reminders are only ever materialised one occurrence ahead, so this bounds the first occurrence. Clamped to 1-3650 days.
How long delivered, cancelled, and failed reminders are kept before the scheduler purges them. Set to 0 to purge as soon as they are finished. Clamped to 0-365 days.
Logs scheduler and API activity at debug level. Reminder descriptions and message contents are never logged at any level.
